title: PREFER: Personalized Review Summarization with Online Preference Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.05911v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Product reviews significantly influence purchasing decisions on e-commerce platforms. However, the sheer volume of reviews can overwhelm users, obscuring information most relevant to their individual needs. Existing e-commerce summarization systems typically produce generic, static summaries that fail to account for the fact that (i) different users prioritize different product characteristics, and (ii) these preferences may evolve with interactions. To address these challenges, we propose an online learning framework that generates personalized summaries for each user by representing user interests in a latent aspect space and selecting preference-aligned review evidence. Our system then iteratively refines its understanding of user preferences by incorporating feedback on the generated summaries directly over time. We evaluate our framework on Amazon Reviews'23 using controlled feedback simulations and robustness checks with held-o

translated_title: PREFER：基于在线偏好学习的个性化评论摘要
translated_abstract: 产品评论对电子商务平台上的购买决策有着重大影响。然而，海量的评论会让用户不堪重负，掩盖了与其个人需求最相关的信息。现有的电商摘要系统通常生成通用且静态的摘要，未能考虑到以下事实：（i）不同用户重视的产品特征各不相同；（ii）这些偏好可能会随着交互而演变。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一个在线学习框架，通过在潜在方面空间中表示用户兴趣，并选择与用户偏好一致的评论证据，为每个用户生成个性化摘要。随后，系统会随着时间推移，通过直接吸收用户对生成摘要的反馈，迭代地完善其对用户偏好的理解。我们在 Amazon Reviews'23 数据集上，采用受控反馈模拟以及基于保留用户的稳健性检验对该框架进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文提出了PREFER框架，通过在潜在方面空间中建模用户兴趣并利用用户反馈进行在线迭代优化，为电商用户生成随偏好动态演化的个性化评论摘要。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes PREFER, an online learning framework that generates personalized product review summaries by representing user interests in a latent aspect space and iteratively refining user preferences through feedback over time.
